feat(transport): answer list_sessions over the socket (#144)

Thread the session store into createMessageHandler and answer
list_sessions beside ping: off the per-session lock, so a history
request never queues behind a streaming answer, but still in arrival
order per socket, so a pong trails the answers before it and a client
can settle on one.

The user id is the session's, never a field of the frame. A store
without listFor answers an empty list; one that rejects is answered
with one error frame and logged on the ws category with the session
id, the user id and no store detail.

The acceptance suite's helpers move to wsTestSupport, clearing the
copies it had made of sessionResume's.
